input.summary: Insert a new Section 14.10 requiring Commerce One to maintain commercial general liability, professional liability and cyber liability insurance and to provide certificates on request; renumber Complete Understanding.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance provision, as the Agreement currently has none even though Commerce One's consultants and professional services personnel support our hosted environment and its MarketSite.net Service handles our and our Customers' data. Our playbook position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and, where Customer Data is processed, cyber cover of USD 5M, with certificates on request; we can discuss E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M if the higher limits are a problem.

ops.text: 14.10 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence and Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000) in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000); (c) where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than Five Million Dollars ($5,000,000); and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Commerce One shall provide Corio with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon Corio's request.
